title: ADENE reports unauthorised intrusion into its IT systems; energy certification portal offline
date_note: The source page gives only its own publication day (23 November); it does not say when the intrusion began.
geo_basis: country, as the source names a Portuguese agency without a city
summary: ADENE, Portugal's energy agency, says it was the target of an unauthorised intrusion into its IT systems and has activated its incident response plan. It says the Energy Certification System (SCE), including the SCE Portal, is temporarily unavailable as a precaution, with no return date. ADENE says the nature and extent are still being established and it cannot yet confirm whether personal data was accessed.
plain: Portugal's energy agency ADENE says someone broke into its systems. Its energy certification portal is offline as a precaution and it is not yet known whether personal data was accessed.
exec: ADENE says its energy certification system is down after an intrusion, with no return date and no confirmation yet on personal data.
action: ADENE advises being careful with emails, messages or calls mentioning the incident that ask for personal data or credentials in its name, and using only its official channels.

evidence.quote: A ADENE – Agência para a Energia foi alvo de uma intrusão não autorizada nos seus sistemas informáticos

validation.note: Only Jornal Económico, quoting ADENE's statement, was read; ADENE's own page (adene.pt) was not read.
